contracts_rationale: Test remediation plus one internal renderer helper; no external interface, endpoint or payload shape is added or changed.
purpose_context: Six nightly issues trace to deliberate contract changes whose PRs stayed green because the failing tests live in out-of-matrix trees that only the nightly runs. Five are stale test pins that must be re-pinned at least as strongly as before; one (#7178) is a real production violation of the git-remedies gate that needs a new canonical renderer. The goal is an honest green nightly for these nodes.
purpose_tldr: Turn the cheap red nightly nodes on main (#7177, #7178, #7111, #7181, #7182, #7183) green by re-pinning stale tests and fixing one production git-remedies violation, without weakening any guard.
